summary: The compositor and layer system saw robustness and scrolling fixes that make graphics rendering more reliable and less janky. Work touched WebRender and compositor plumbing (layer tree checks, rejecting duplicate LayersId in scroll data) and improved APZC (Async Pan/Zoom Controller) behavior so handed‑off pan gestures and scrolling state are tracked correctly; this reduces odd re-snapping and repaint glitches during touch scrolls. Importantly, **HDR metadata from hardware‑decoded video is now passed through to the compositor**, fixing washed-out colors on HDR videos. Several safety checks and bug fixes also harden remote texture handling and iterator safety.
